Plan, Stage, and Publish a Cumulative Benchmark Release

Source: R/upload.R
publish_benchmark_release.Rd

A plan combines unchanged references from a previous catalog with new files. Changing an existing shard requires listing its ID in replace. Archive publication builds complete changed download units, imports unchanged ZIPs into native storage versions and continues the native catalog family. Publication makes the complete catalog available after anonymous access and size checks of every advertised archive, payload/member checks of the archives it uploaded, and native rights, DOI relationship and accepted community checks have passed.

Usage

plan_benchmark_release(
  release,
  files,
  conditions = NULL,
  previous = NULL,
  replace = character(),
  metadata,
  state_directory,
  max_files = 100L,
  max_bytes = 5e+10,
  sandbox = FALSE,
  package_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("PublicationBiasBenchmark")),
  source_commit = NULL,
  provenance = NULL,
  community = "publicationbiasbenchmark",
  catalog_record_id = NULL,
  catalog_concept_doi = NULL,
  max_archive_bytes = .archive_byte_limit
)

stage_benchmark_release(plan, token = NULL)

verify_benchmark_release(plan, token = NULL)

publish_benchmark_release(plan, token = NULL, confirm = NULL)

Arguments

release

New benchmark release identifier.

files

List of descriptors returned by benchmark_resource.

conditions

Named list of frozen DGM condition data frames.

previous

Previous release identifier or catalog, or NULL for the baseline.

replace

IDs of existing shards intentionally replaced.

metadata

Zenodo-native metadata list including creators and rights (license IDs).

state_directory

Directory for resumable publication state, outside Git.

max_files

Maximum uploaded files per component record (at most 100).

max_bytes

Maximum component size (at most 50 billion bytes).

sandbox

Use sandbox.zenodo.org and a separate sandbox token.

package_version

Package version assembling the release (generation stamps remain per file).

source_commit

Source commit for the frozen DGM definitions.

provenance

Optional source archive metadata stored in the catalog.

community

Community slug or UUID. Required for archive publication.

catalog_record_id

Existing catalog family version ID, required to consolidate a schema-1 release.

catalog_concept_doi

Existing catalog family concept DOI.

max_archive_bytes

Uncompressed ZIP cap, at most 2,000,000,000 bytes.

plan

Release plan.

token

Zenodo token; defaults to ZENODO_TOKEN (ZENODO_SANDBOX_TOKEN for sandbox).

confirm

Required to publish: the release identifier of the plan, repeated explicitly. Publishing is irreversible.

Value

plan_benchmark_release returns a plan; staging returns the staged catalog; publication returns a registry entry including the catalog's version DOI and hash.

Details

These functions are maintainer-only and not exported; call them as PublicationBiasBenchmark:::plan_benchmark_release() (see .github/RELEASING.md in the GitHub repository). Staging and publishing first check that the token's account is an owner or manager of the benchmark community (the gate), take an exclusive lock on the state directory and bind the state to the plan. The gate protects this package's entry points; it is not a security boundary for Zenodo itself.
